title: Human-Feedback-Guided Multi-Agent Inverse Reinforcement Learning for Interactive Driving Behavior Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.33726v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modeling human driving behavior is fundamental to understanding driver decision-making and supporting autonomous vehicles (AVs) in mixed traffic. Reward learning offers a principled way to infer the latent objectives behind driving behaviors, yet most existing methods are formulated in single-agent settings and treat surrounding vehicles as dynamic obstacles. Directly extending reward learning to multi-agent scenarios is difficult because the joint action space grows exponentially with the number of interacting vehicles. In addition, existing approaches mainly rely on physical demonstrations and rarely exploit human feedback during reward recovery. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a Human-Feedback-Guided Multi-Agent Inverse Reinforcement Learning (HFG-MAIRL) framework for interactive driving behavior modeling. translated_title: 基于人类反馈引导的多智能体逆强化学习的交互式驾驶行为建模
translated_abstract: 对人类驾驶行为进行建模是理解驾驶员决策制定以及支持自动驾驶汽车在混合交通中运行的基础。奖励学习提供了一种有原则的方法来推断驾驶行为背后的潜在目标，然而大多数现有方法都是在单智能体设置下构建的，并将周围车辆视为动态障碍物。将奖励学习直接扩展到多智能体场景是困难的，因为联合动作空间会随着交互车辆数量的增加而呈指数级增长。此外，现有方法主要依赖物理演示数据，很少在奖励恢复过程中利用人类反馈。为解决这些局限性，本文提出了一种用于交互式驾驶行为建模的人类反馈引导多智能体逆强化学习（HFG-MAIRL）框架。首先，我们开发了一个多智能体最大熵逆强化学习模块，该模块显式地对每辆（车进行建模）……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出人类反馈引导的多智能体逆强化学习框架（HFG-MAIRL），通过多智能体最大熵逆强化学习模块显式建模交互车辆并结合人类反馈进行奖励恢复，从而有效解决联合动作空间爆炸问题并实现交互式驾驶行为建模。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes HFG-MAIRL, a Human-Feedback-Guided Multi-Agent Inverse Reinforcement Learning framework that models interactive driving behavior by explicitly modeling interacting vehicles through a multi-agent maximum-entropy IRL module and leveraging human feedback for reward recovery, addressing the exponential growth of joint action space.
